findings.https_get_limit: Application-level maximum one GET can be specified but does not establish count of resolver operations
findings.dns: aiohttp resolver may use asyncio / getaddrinfo and operating-system resolution; A/AAAA, caches and runtime resolver work cannot be reliably counted from GET=1 alone
findings.runner: ubuntu-latest image and preinstalled components may change; pin image family and inspect exact version before any future authorization
findings.current_proof: NO VERIFIED BOUND ON INDIVIDUAL DNS QUERIES; no outbound diagnostic performed

conditions_before_future_approval: Document whether count means resolver calls, DNS questions or transmitted packets; these quantities differ
Pin runner image and record read-only resolver configuration evidence
Choose auditable resolver or approved network egress boundary; prove fail-closed controls with offline tests before any live request
Specify DNS request/operation budget independently, including A/AAAA, CNAME, cache and redirects; if cannot enforce, remain blocked
Obtain owner approval for exact one-time UTC window, DNS scope and HTTPS GET separately
Maintain no hidden retry, redirects, clock-skew second GET, token/body disclosure or synthesis
